dogecoin.text: JUST IN: 🚀 @BitOrigin becomes the first listed US company to adopt Dogecoin as a core asset, planning a $500M venture to boost Doge holdings and explore its payment potential. CEO Jinghai Jiang cites Doge's community strength and utility as key drivers. $BOTG https://t.co/2GdRwiOE3V

JUST IN: 🚀 @BitOrigin announces a strategic acquisition of 40.5M Dogecoin under a $500M capital facility for its digital asset treasury. CEO Jinghai Jiang cites Dogecoin's utility for micropayments and growing developer activity as key motivators. $BOTG https://t.co/WvGAxi0y3u

JUST IN: 🚀 @BitOrigin announces closing a private placement, acquiring 20M Class A shares for 30M DOGE to boost its Dogecoin treasury. Current DOGE holdings at over 70M with an average cost of ~$0.2268/DOGE. Aims to build one of the largest DOGE treasuries among public firms. https://t.co/TxuRfeLKc0
